comments.body:
Hello, I plan to write down on every Adepts of Ages all the locations where these titles can be used for Astronomy. If you have any informations, please write them on the appropriate title to help future Astronomer.
Thanks You :D

Adept 15.1 Can be used in the Gulf of Guinea to discover Antares

Additionally, here is the Prince Henrique/Jose storyline. Repeating these quests once they've been completed is not possible, unless another player who hasn't done them yet can pull them for you as fleet admiral. (The final one may be repeatable; I haven't tested it yet.) I've set this chain aside to avoid mixing them up with other quests.
